race.comment: HE'S REGAL (6) was well backed on debut at Sale and just missed a nose in an encouraging effort. Expected to improve off that and Blake Shinn sticks. He draws perfectly and will be very hard to catch. PRINCE OF PORTLAND (9) has placed in both runs back, backing up the fresh run with a narrow defeat at Ballarat Synthetic last time. Onto turf now but that should be fine and he can figure. AEMOND (3) is a well-bred colt by Written Tycoon on debut for the Freedman yard. Represents strong connections and Zahra booked, keeping safe. STAY INDOORS (12) ran well on debut behind HE'S REGAL and maps well. Can figure again.
